question: Does the Internet Archive JP2 derivative for CISI Pakistan page n374 improve H-940 B enough to change the local 110 / Parpola sign-no.-41 branch gate?
result: No upgrade. The direct IA JP2 archive member has the same 3258 x 4550 pixel geometry as the checked IIIF max route. H-940 B remains low-contrast and visually split as paired/wavy vertical forms, not a clean compound branching figure comparable to H-2148.

accepted_claims.h940_status: H-940 B remains source-visible but visually split/non-binding at current public quality.

not_accepted: H-940 rejoins the H-2148 branch through the public JP2 route
next_gate: Do not keep spending effort on IA page derivatives for H-940 B. Acquire an independent source-grade crop, original plate/photo, HARP/CISI source note, or side-label transcription.
